name: Inerrancy
overview: Scripture affirms the inerrancy of God's Word, describing it as pure, perfect, and unbreakable. The Psalms emphasize the purity and perfection of the Lord’s words, likening them to silver refined seven times and a shield for those who trust in Him. Jesus Himself affirmed the enduring truth of Scripture, asserting that not even the smallest part of the law will pass away until all is fulfilled. This unwavering reliability underscores that every word proceeding from God is trustworthy and essential for spiritual life and wisdom.
